evidence_at_a_glance.qualitative_result: In the original CHAARTED analysis of 790 people with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, ADT plus six cycles of docetaxel gave median overall survival of 57.6 versus 44.0 months with ADT alone; hazard ratio 0.61 (95% CI 0.47–0.80), with median follow-up 28.9 months. Do not transfer this result to nonmetastatic disease: long-term STAMPEDE M0 analysis did not establish an overall-survival advantage (HR 0.88, 95% CI 0.64–1.21). These are different populations and historical comparators, not a comparison with contemporary triplet treatment.
